info.title: Gelatin Partner DJ Booking API
info.description: Partner-scoped HTTP API for listing Gelatin DJs, submitting booking requests, handing organizers to Gelatin's hosted booking page, and reading booking status. Pre-release: the contract may change before 1.0.

get.summary: Read approved DJs and advisory availability

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City, with or without its US state: "Atlanta, GA", "Atlanta" and "Atlanta, Georgia" return the same DJs. Use a label from listPartnerCities. Returns DJs whose profile names that city, plus, for a city in the SDK's US_MAJOR_CITIES, DJs whose service radius covers it. Case and surrounding whitespace are ignored. This is the default city rule; Gelatin can set a partner to exact-name matching, which returns only DJs whose profile city is exactly the query text (case and surrounding whitespace still ignored), with no aliases or service radius.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: One genre from the DJ's profile. Case, accents, whitespace and punctuation are ignored, so "Deep-House" and "deep house" return the same DJs; there is no synonym list. Use a name from listPartnerGenres. A genre no DJ lists returns an empty page, not an error. Text with no letters or digits is rejected.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Calendar date for advisory availability. When omitted with no set window, available is false. Cannot be combined with a set window.

parameters.name: set_starts_at
parameters.description: The start of the organizer's chosen set time, with an offset and URL-encoded. Send it with set_ends_at and time_zone, and available is advisory for that window instead of a whole date.

parameters.name: set_ends_at
parameters.description: The end of the set window, after set_starts_at.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.description: The event's IANA time zone, for the set window's calendar dates.

parameters.name: available
parameters.description: Only with date: return only the DJs free that night (every item has available true), so a page never holds a DJ the organizer can't book. Uses the same rule as available. Without it, every DJ is returned with their own available. Without date, or with any value but true, it is rejected with 400 invalid_query. A cursor from one choice is refused for the other.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Budget bands, comma-separated, each at most once: under_300 (below $300), 300_to_600 ($300 up to but not including $600), 600_to_1000 ($600 up to but not including $1,000), 1000_plus ($1,000 and up). Lower bounds are inclusive, so $300 exactly is in 300_to_600, $600 in 600_to_1000 and $1,000 in 1000_plus. Returns DJs whose real minimum rate is in any listed band, including DJs who keep their rate private; their published_rate_cents stays null and results stay ordered by ID, so a response reveals only band membership. A DJ with no rate on file is in no band. Combines with city and date: every filter must match. An unknown, empty or repeated band, or a repeated budget parameter, is rejected with 400 invalid_query. The SDK exports the bands as BUDGET_BANDS from @gelatinbookings/partner-sdk/budget.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset position bound to the authenticated partner and city, genre, date and budget filters. Eligibility is checked again on every page.

get.description: Requires catalog:read. Only active DJs approved by partner distribution settings, with partner exclusions taking precedence. Only published partner-allowlisted fields; hidden rates stay null. Availability requires a date, payout readiness and no known date conflict; rechecked at each mutation. Unknown or duplicate query parameters are rejected. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

get.summary: Read one DJ's full public profile

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Gelatin's DJ ID, as PublicDj.id returns it.

get.description: Requires catalog:read. Mounted. Everything public about one DJ in your catalog: bio, photo and gallery, genres, verified draw, published rate, rating, recent anonymous reviews, listen links, public socials, upcoming public nights and the profile links. The DJ must be one listPartnerDjs can return for you: active, distributed to you, and not excluded. Any other id, including a malformed one, is 404 not_found, the same answer as for an unknown DJ. Never carries contact details: no email or phone, and emails, phone numbers and chat links typed into the bio or a review are replaced with [removed]. Reviews carry their words, day and venue only, never who wrote them. Takes no query parameters; any is 400 invalid_query.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Gelatin's DJ ID, as PublicDj.id returns it.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. No earlier than yesterday (UTC) and no more than two years ahead.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, included. The range is at most 90 days in all.

parameters.name: time_zone
parameters.description: The event's IANA time zone, as for listPartnerDjs' set window. Each day is then midnight to midnight in that zone, checked as a set window is. Without it, each day is judged as listPartnerDjs' date is.

get.description: Requires catalog:read. Mounted. Each day in the range is available or unavailable, by the same rules as the catalog's available: the DJ can be paid, and has no blackout, live Gelatin booking or published outside night that day. Never says why a day is unavailable or what the DJ is doing. Advisory: Gelatin checks again when you send the request, and reading this holds nothing. The same DJs as getPartnerDj; any other id is 404 not_found. A missing, malformed, reversed or too-long range, an unknown time zone, or any other parameter is 400 invalid_query.

get.summary: List US states and major cities with this partner's DJ counts

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

200.description: Directory of cities grouped by country and state

get.description: Requires catalog:read. Every US state and DC with its major cities (the SDK's US_MAJOR_CITIES: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2024, the 200 most populous places plus each state's most populous), plus any other city a DJ in this partner's catalog names. dj_count is the number of DJs listPartnerDjs returns for that city's label, under the partner's city rule. By default that is DJs whose profile names the city, plus, for a bundled city, DJs whose service radius covers it. A partner on exact-name matching sees each stored city spelling as its own entry, counted by exact name only. It applies the same distribution settings and exclusions. Cities with no DJs stay listed with dj_count 0. No coordinates, radii or DJ identifiers are returned. Cities Gelatin cannot place in a US state are grouped under a country with a null code. Takes no query parameters; any are rejected. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

post.summary: Ask to be told when a city has DJs (mounted)
post.description: Requires `requests:write` and counts against the partner's write quota. Send it when an organizer picks a city with `dj_count: 0` and asks to be told when DJs are available there. `city` must be the `label` of a bundled US city from listPartnerCities (the SDK's US_MAJOR_CITIES); `consent` must be `true`. Gelatin stores the email lower-cased with the city, its state, the source and the time of the request, once per email, city and partner. The response never contains the email or any other sign-up. Gelatin sends no email from this route. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required on every write. A sign-up is already one row per email and city, so a retry with any key lands on the same row.

200.description: `already_subscribed`: this email already asked for this city through this partner. The first consent time is kept.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is invalid or over 2 KiB, has unknown fields, the email is not an address of at most 254 characters, the city is not a bundled city label, `consent` is not `true`, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or longer than 255 characters. `invalid_query`: the URL has query parameters. Fields are never echoed.

503.description: `temporarily_unavailable` with `Retry-After: 30`: retry; a repeat lands on the same sign-up.

get.summary: List the genres this partner's DJs list, with DJ counts

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: A city label from listPartnerCities. Only DJs listPartnerDjs returns for this city are counted, by the same rule (named city or service radius). Omit for every city.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Same bands and format as listPartnerDjs budget. When set, only DJs in those bands are counted, so each count is what listPartnerDjs returns for that city, budget and genre.

200.description: Genres present among this partner's DJs, busiest first

get.description: Requires catalog:read. The genres listed by the DJs this partner may show (same distribution settings and exclusions as listPartnerDjs), optionally in one city and budget bands. dj_count is the number of DJs listPartnerDjs returns for that city, budget and genre. Spellings that differ only in case, accents, whitespace or punctuation are one genre, named by the spelling most of its DJs use. Only genres with at least one DJ are listed, busiest first, at most 100. No DJ identifiers are returned. Accepts only the city and budget query parameters; others are rejected. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

post.summary: Create one partner booking with one or more DJ engagements

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

409.description: `conflict`: the idempotency key or an external request was reused with different terms. `dj_unavailable`: a selected DJ cannot take this event; nothing was created and the whole submission rolled back. Offer another DJ or change the schedule, then submit with a new idempotency key. `503 temporarily_unavailable` is reserved for outages.

error.message: A selected DJ is not available for this event.

post.description: One stable partner booking groups independently negotiated and payable DJ engagements. Each DJ requires its own authorization; no combined charge or all-or-nothing acceptance.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

get.description: Requires bookings:read. Mounted. Resolves the event only through the authenticated partner's own external_event_id; an unknown event and another partner's event both return the same 404. Each request reports authorization_required until a signed hold exists on its current offer; requested while the DJ considers a held offer, including acceptance awaiting a signed capture; reauthorization_required when the DJ countered or the offer changed: a counteroffer releases the earlier hold, so the organizer must approve the new total and place a new hold; negotiating is reserved for a counter open while a hold is still valid, which the current flow does not produce; confirmed only after Gelatin records the signed capture; and declined, expired or cancelled when it ends. The actions array is currently always empty: portal links are single-use, so mint one with the portal launch route when the organizer acts rather than on each read. revision stays 0 until event change submission is mounted; use the ETag for change detection. ETag and If-None-Match return 304 with no body. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

get.summary: List alternates after a DJ passes, an offer expires or a request is lost

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: A request_id from getEventBookings or submitBookingRequests.

200.description: Who else is open for the lost slot

get.description: Requires bookings:read. Only for a request whose status is declined, expired or cancelled; a live request answers 409 request_active. Returns up to five DJs from this partner's catalog who are available on the event's own calendar date, in its city (from the venue address, else the lost DJ's city; matched by the partner's city rule, as in listPartnerDjs), and who publish a rate within the organizer's last offered DJ fee plus a fifth, or publish none. The lost DJ and every DJ already asked for this event are left out. Ordered by published rate, nearest the budget first; private rates never filter or order. Includes the partner's own event details to prefill a new request. Reading this creates no booking, hold or payment. Unknown and another partner's requests are indistinguishable (404). Takes no query parameters. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Pass pending to add DJs who have the offer and haven't settled it yet, for a TBA slot. Omit for confirmed DJs only.

get.description: Requires bookings:read. Mounted. Who is playing at one of your events, safe to show on a public event page: each DJ's id, name, public profile link and photo, plus a confirmed DJ's set time and sound when known, and nothing about price, offers or the organizer. Resolves the event only through the authenticated partner's own external_event_id; an unknown event and another partner's event both return the same 404. By default it lists only DJs whose booking is confirmed (Gelatin recorded the signed capture). include=pending also lists DJs who have the offer and haven't settled it (requested, negotiating or reauthorization_required in getEventBookings) with status pending; a request still waiting for the organizer's first card hold is never listed, because the DJ hasn't seen it. Declined, expired and cancelled bookings are simply absent. Pending entries carry no set time or sound. Entries with a set time come first, in time order. A DJ appears once per event, and a DJ removed from your catalog distribution is left out. Link the name to profile_url wherever it is shown. ETag and If-None-Match return 304 with no body. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store.

patch.summary: Send a monotonic event change or cancellation

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

post.summary: Submit one partner booking with one or more DJ requests (mounted)
post.description: Requires `requests:write`. Body at most 64 KiB. `authorization_placement` is `partner_event_flow` when your page takes the first card hold with `POST /payment-sessions`, or `gelatin_portal_handoff` when the organizer pays in Gelatin through a portal launch. Both stay able to use the portal, which is where a DJ's counteroffer is reviewed. `return_url` must use an origin Gelatin registered for the partner. Only `external_event_id` and `organizer.external_user_id` identify the booking; `external_booking_id` and each `external_request_id` are optional, and `external_submission_id` is deprecated and ignored. This part of the contract is still proposed. With `payment: "event_checkout"`, the key also needs `launch:write`, and the result carries `event_checkout` (as `POST /payment-sessions` with `resource: { kind: "event" }` returns it) or, when the booking was made but the checkout could not open, `event_checkout_error`.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409. Without an `external_booking_id`, it is also what makes a retry the same booking, so reuse it for retries of the same request only. The SDK defaults it to `booking:<external_booking_id>`, or to `submission:<sha-256 of the request>` when there is no booking ID.

201.description: Created; a same-key retry with the same body returns the original result

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON, is over 64 KiB, fails the schema (including a `dj_fee_cents` above 100,000,000 or a non-USD currency), uses a return URL outside your registered return origins, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing, padded or longer than 255 characters. Field details are never echoed. Fix the request; do not retry it unchanged.

403.description: `organizer_owes`: Make a Deal is on for your integration and the organizer's community (or the organizer themselves) owes a DJ. Refused on every event the community runs; nothing was created. Read `GET /organizers/{community_ref}/standing` and retry after the DJ confirms payment. Other 403 codes are credential errors.

404.description: `not_found`: your partner integration is switched off. Contact Gelatin; retrying will not help.

409.description: Permanent; do not retry unchanged. `dj_unavailable` (with `external_request_id` and `dj_id`): that request's DJ is unknown, inactive, already booked, blacked out, excluded from your catalog or not yet payable. Nothing was created and the whole submission rolled back; offer another DJ or change the schedule, then submit with a new idempotency key. `conflict`: the idempotency key was reused with a different body, the `external_booking_id` was already submitted with different terms or belongs to another event or organizer, an `external_request_id` already belongs to another booking or DJ, or the `external_event_id` belongs to another organizer. `event_checkout_unavailable`: `payment: "event_checkout"` was sent but saved cards aren't on for your partner; nothing was created, so send it again without `payment`.

error.message: A selected DJ is not available for this event.
This booking request conflicts with an earlier submission.

503.description: `temporarily_unavailable` with `Retry-After: 30`: a Gelatin outage. Retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` and the same body.

post.summary: Create a single-use organizer portal launch for one DJ engagement (mounted)
post.description: Requires `launch:write`. The resource must belong to the same partner, external event and external organizer. The returned URL carries a one-use secret in its fragment and expires after 60 seconds; redirect the organizer immediately and never log it. `return_url` must use a registered return origin.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

201.description: Created; a same-key retry with the same body returns the original result

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is invalid or over 2 KiB, has unknown fields, the `return_url` is outside your registered return origins or contains credentials, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing, padded or longer than 255 characters.

404.description: `resource_unavailable`: no request or booking with that id belongs to this partner, event and organizer, or it can no longer be opened.

409.description: `idempotency_conflict`: this `Idempotency-Key` was already used for a different launch body. Use a new key for a new launch.

503.description: `temporarily_unavailable` with `Retry-After: 30`: retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body; you get the same link back.

post.summary: Start or resume the card hold for an organizer's initial offer, or one checkout for every DJ on their event, on your page (mounted)
post.description: Requires `launch:write`. The request must belong to the same partner, external event and external organizer, and its current offer must be the one the organizer submitted; a DJ's counteroffer returns 409 `portal_required` and is reviewed in Gelatin through a portal launch. Returns an embedded Stripe Checkout for the organizer's browser to mount with Stripe.js (`createEmbeddedCheckoutPage`) using `publishable_key`. The client secret opens only this checkout; send it to that organizer's browser only and never log it. Card details go to Stripe directly. Completing the checkout does not by itself place the hold: read booking status, which changes once Stripe confirms the hold to Gelatin. One open hold exists per offer: any key, and the Gelatin portal, resume the same checkout. With `resource: { kind: "event" }` it instead opens one setup checkout that saves a card for this event; the consent shows inside it, above its button. Once Stripe confirms the card to Gelatin, Gelatin places one hold per DJ on the event in the background, each within the organizer's hold limits and each with a receipt email. A DJ added to the event later is held on the same card automatically. A DJ whose hold the card refuses, wants 3D Secure for, or that is over a limit stays `authorization_required`: create a portal launch for them. Every event gets its own checkout and its own card; one event's card never holds another event's DJs. Only for partners with saved cards on. Any key resumes the same open checkout; once the event's card is saved, no second checkout opens.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Key for this call; a retry with the same key and body returns the same checkout. A fresh key per click is fine: Gelatin resumes the open hold for the offer.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is invalid or over 2 KiB, has unknown fields, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing, padded or longer than 255 characters.

404.description: `resource_unavailable`: no request with that id, or no event for that organizer, belongs to this partner.

409.description: `portal_required`: the current offer is a DJ's counteroffer, or its hold was started on a Stripe-hosted page; create a portal launch. `offer_changed`: the offer changed, was already authorized or has expired; read booking status. `dj_unavailable`: the DJ can no longer take this booking. For `event`: `event_checkout_unavailable`, saved cards aren't on for your partner, or this event's card already refused a DJ who still needs payment, so create a payment session (or a portal launch) for each DJ still `authorization_required`; `nothing_to_pay`, every DJ on the event is held, or being held, on its card.

503.description: `temporarily_unavailable` with `Retry-After: 30`: retry; you get the same open checkout back.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: external_user_id
parameters.description: An organizer's user ID: include their own record on your platform, exactly as a booking request from them is checked.

404.description: `not_found`: Make a Deal is not enabled for your integration.

get.description: Requires bookings:read. Mounted. Whether a community may add talent, and what it owes DJs directly on Make a Deal bookings: each amount, the request it came from and when it fell due. Gate your own Add talent control on `may_add_talent`. Pull-only: there is no standing webhook.

post.description: Requires `requests:write`. Reads only: what cancelling now would refund to the organizer, what the DJ keeps, what Gelatin keeps, and the rule in words to show before the organizer confirms. Partner policy: before the DJ accepts and the hold is charged, cancelling is free and the hold is released. After the charge: 7 or more days before the event, everything is refunded except card processing; between 48 hours and 7 days, the DJ keeps half their fee and half is refunded; inside 48 hours, the DJ keeps their whole fee. Gelatin's service fee and card processing aren't refunded inside 7 days. Once the event starts, it can't be cancelled. On Make a Deal nothing is refunded: `dj_keeps_cents` is what the organizer owes the DJ directly. A booking that can't be cancelled answers 200 with `cancellable: false` and a `blocked_reason`.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The engagement's `booking_id` from `submitBookingRequests` (one per DJ). Another partner's booking, or none, is the same 404.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the booking id isn't a UUID, the body has fields (send none, or `{}`), or the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or longer than 255 characters.

404.description: `not_found`: no booking with that id belongs to this partner.

post.description: Requires `requests:write`. Applies the same plan the preview showed, through Gelatin's own refund and payout handling: refunds are queued and sent by Gelatin, never by this call. The DJ's request is withdrawn and the DJ is told. `dj-bookings` then shows the request as `cancelled` with a new ETag, and `lineup` drops the DJ. Partner policy: before the DJ accepts and the hold is charged, cancelling is free and the hold is released. After the charge: 7 or more days before the event, everything is refunded except card processing; between 48 hours and 7 days, the DJ keeps half their fee and half is refunded; inside 48 hours, the DJ keeps their whole fee. Gelatin's service fee and card processing aren't refunded inside 7 days. Once the event starts, it can't be cancelled. On Make a Deal nothing is refunded: `dj_keeps_cents` is what the organizer owes the DJ directly. A retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the original answer; cancelling an already cancelled booking answers with what its cancellation recorded and `already_cancelled: true`, and moves no money. A date change means cancelling and sending a new request.

parameters.name: partner
parameters.description: Partner slug; the bearer key must be scoped to this same partner.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: The engagement's `booking_id` from `submitBookingRequests` (one per DJ). Another partner's booking, or none, is the same 404.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable key for one logical write. Same key and body return the original result; a changed body returns 409.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the booking id isn't a UUID, the body has fields (send none, or `{}`), or the `Idempotency-Key` header is missing or longer than 255 characters.

404.description: `not_found`: no booking with that id belongs to this partner.

409.description: `not_cancellable`: the event has started or the booking otherwise can't be cancelled now, or this `Idempotency-Key` was used to cancel a different booking.

PartnerBearer.description: Server-side only. Separate scoped sandbox and production keys.

Error.description: Narrow error envelope; no raw provider or personal data

external_request_id.description: Present only on `dj_unavailable`: the partner's `external_request_id` whose DJ cannot take the event. The reason (booked, blacked out, not distributed or not payout-ready) is deliberately not disclosed.

dj_id.description: Present only on a submission's `dj_unavailable`: the DJ who cannot take the event, so a partner that left request IDs to Gelatin can tell which one.

profile_page_url.description: The DJ's public profile. By default, the co-branded page on the partner's active portal origin (https://<portal origin>/djs/{slug}), or Gelatin's /djs page when it has none. Gelatin can set a partner to always link to Gelatin's /djs page. Link to this one.

profile_url.description: Deprecated: use profile_page_url. The same page in its older form, https://<portal origin>/partner/djs/{slug} on a portal origin, which redirects (308) to profile_page_url. Kept so existing integrations keep working; no removal date yet. Without a portal origin it equals profile_page_url.

oneOf.description: Verified draw: venue-confirmed head counts over the window, excluding disputed and auto-confirmed ones. Null when the DJ has no verified night; never 0.

genres.description: Up to six genres from the DJ's profile, in the DJ's own order; empty when the DJ lists none. When the catalog was filtered by genre, that genre is first. Added after the first release: clients should treat a missing field as an empty list.

available.description: Advisory only. False without a requested date, payout readiness, or when a known date conflict applies. A true result does not reserve a slot; each paid mutation rechecks eligibility and timing.

label.description: Send as the city query of listPartnerDjs.

dj_count.description: DJs listPartnerDjs returns for this label. Zero is listed, not hidden.

code.description: US state code, or null for cities not placed in a state.
Country code, or null for cities not placed in a country.

email.description: The organizer's email; stored trimmed and lower-cased.

city.description: A bundled city's label from listPartnerCities, such as "Boise, ID".

consent.description: True only after the organizer asked to be told.

source.description: Where the ask came from, such as empty_state. Defaults to partner_api.

name.description: The spelling most of these DJs use. Pass it as genre to listPartnerDjs.

community_ref.description: Your ID for the community that runs the event. Required when any request is `make_a_deal`. Amounts owed attach to the community, so a colleague creating the next event cannot shed them. Set once per event; a different value later is a `409 conflict`.

ends_at.description: Must be later than starts_at. The server never invents a DJ engagement duration.

time_zone.description: An IANA timezone accepted by Gelatin, such as America/New_York.

venue_address.description: Optional street address of the venue. Gelatin shows it to the DJ in their invitation, inbox and booking page.

external_request_id.description: Optional. Your ID for this DJ request. Left out, Gelatin derives one (`gelatin:…`) and returns it in `engagements[].external_request_id`; use `request_id` for later calls.

set_starts_at.description: The time the organizer chose for this DJ's set, with an offset, inside the event. Send both set fields or neither. Gelatin checks the DJ against this window instead of the whole event.

set_ends_at.description: The end of the set, after set_starts_at and no later than the event's ends_at.

external_event_id.description: Required. Your event ID; status is read back by it.

external_submission_id.description: Deprecated: accepted and ignored. Leave it out.

external_booking_id.description: Optional. Your booking ID: accepted once, so the same booking under any key returns the original result, and different terms are a `409 conflict`. Left out, the `Idempotency-Key` does that job: a retry under the same key returns the original result, and a later send under a new key adds DJs to the same event as its own booking. Gelatin derives the stored value (`gelatin:…`) from the event, the organizer and the key.

payment.description: Optional: also open one checkout for every DJ on the event and return it as `event_checkout`, so your page can mount Stripe from this one call. Needs `launch:write` as well as `requests:write`, and saved cards on for your partner.

partner_booking_id.description: Gelatin partner booking group ID; not an individual DJ booking or payment ID.

launch_url.description: The one-use portal link, https://<portal origin>/launch#token=…. Redirect the organizer to this one straight away.

url.description: Deprecated: use launch_url. The same one-use link in its older form, https://<portal origin>/partner/launch#token=…, which redirects (308) to /launch keeping the token. Kept so existing integrations keep working; no removal date yet.

deal.description: Present only for `make_a_deal`: no hold is ever required, so the request is never `authorization_required`.

request_id.description: Pass as a portal launch resource of kind `request`.

booking_id.description: Pass as a portal launch resource of kind `booking`.

deal.description: Present only for `make_a_deal`, where `total_cents` is the DJ's fee, paid to the DJ directly.

event_checkout.description: Sent only with `payment: "event_checkout"` when the checkout opened. A replay returns the same open checkout.

event_checkout_error.description: Sent only with `payment: "event_checkout"` when the booking was made but its checkout could not open. Fall back: `nothing_to_pay` → every DJ is held or being held on this event's card, read booking status; `event_checkout_unavailable` → pay per DJ; `temporarily_unavailable` → retry `POST /payment-sessions` with `resource: { kind: "event" }`.

resource.description: `request` starts one DJ's hold. `event` opens one checkout that saves the organizer's card for every DJ on the event; it needs saved cards on for your partner.

client_secret.description: Embedded Stripe Checkout client secret: for `request`, this one hold; for `event`, the setup checkout that saves the organizer's card

publishable_key.description: Gelatin's Stripe publishable key for this environment (`pk_test_` in the sandbox)

total_cents.description: What the organizer authorizes: DJ fee plus Gelatin's service fee and card processing. For `event`, the sum over every DJ the saved card will hold

dj_count.description: Sent only for `event`: how many DJs the saved card will hold once it is saved

profile_page_url.description: The DJ's public profile. By default, the co-branded page on the partner's active portal origin (https://<portal origin>/djs/{slug}), or Gelatin's /djs page when it has none. Gelatin can set a partner to always link to Gelatin's /djs page. Link to this one.

profile_url.description: Deprecated: use profile_page_url. The same page in its older form, https://<portal origin>/partner/djs/{slug} on a portal origin, which redirects (308) to profile_page_url. Kept so existing integrations keep working; no removal date yet. Without a portal origin it equals profile_page_url.

set_starts_at.description: When the DJ's set starts, as a UTC instant. Null when no set time was chosen, and always null on a pending entry. Format it in your event's time zone.

set_ends_at.description: When the DJ's set ends, as a UTC instant. Null under the same conditions as set_starts_at.

sound.description: The sound the DJ is bringing to this set, in their own words, as plain text. Null when they haven't named one, and always null on a pending entry.

dj_id.description: The DJ whose request was lost.

date.description: The event's own calendar date in its time zone.

city.description: A listPartnerCities label, or null when there was no city to go on.

budget.description: The organizer's last offered DJ fee.

PartnerDeal.description: `confirm_and_book` (the default): a card hold, charged when the DJ accepts. `make_a_deal`: no hold and no Gelatin charge; the organizer pays the DJ directly, and while their community owes a DJ it cannot add talent. Make a Deal is enabled per partner and is off by default.

external_request_id.description: Your request the amount came from.

reason.description: `unpaid_fee`: the DJ said a Make a Deal fee was not paid. `cancellation`: the DJ's share of a late organizer cancellation under the 7-day / 48-hour policy.

may_add_talent.description: False while anything is owed. A booking request for any event the community runs is then refused with `403 organizer_owes`.

blocked_reason.description: Why it can't be cancelled now; null when it can.

charged_cents.description: What was charged to the organizer's card. Zero while the card is only held.

refund_cents.description: What goes back to the organizer's card.

dj_keeps_cents.description: Confirm & Book: what Gelatin pays the DJ from the charge. Make a Deal: what the organizer owes the DJ directly.

gelatin_keeps_cents.description: Gelatin's service fee and card processing kept under the policy.

hold_released.description: Nothing was charged; the card hold (or an unfinished checkout) is released.

text.description: The rule in plain words, to show the organizer before they confirm.

blocked_reason.description: Why it can't be cancelled now; null when it can.

charged_cents.description: What was charged to the organizer's card. Zero while the card is only held.

refund_cents.description: What goes back to the organizer's card.

dj_keeps_cents.description: Confirm & Book: what Gelatin pays the DJ from the charge. Make a Deal: what the organizer owes the DJ directly.

gelatin_keeps_cents.description: Gelatin's service fee and card processing kept under the policy.

hold_released.description: Nothing was charged; the card hold (or an unfinished checkout) is released.

text.description: The rule in plain words, to show the organizer before they confirm.

already_cancelled.description: This booking was cancelled before this call.

PartnerDjDetail.description: One DJ's full public profile. Never contact details.

bio.description: The DJ's own words, with emails, phone numbers and chat links replaced by [removed]. Null when they wrote none.

gallery.description: The cover image, hosted set artwork and public performance videos (outside video pages such as YouTube). Public URLs only; uploaded video files aren't included.

genres.description: Every genre the DJ lists, in their order; empty when none.

oneOf.description: Verified draw: venue-confirmed head counts over the window, excluding disputed and auto-confirmed ones. Null when the DJ has no verified night; never 0.

reviews.description: The most recent published reviews with words, newest first. Anonymous: never who wrote them.

text.description: With emails, phone numbers and chat links replaced by [removed].

socials.description: Every public social profile and link the DJ shares, Instagram and TikTok included. Chat links (WhatsApp, Telegram and the like) are left out.

upcoming_gigs.description: Public nights still ahead, soonest first: what the DJ's public profile lists.

source.description: gelatin: booked or listed through Gelatin. self_listed: the DJ added it; unverified.

profile_page_url.description: The DJ's public profile. By default, the co-branded page on the partner's active portal origin (https://<portal origin>/djs/{slug}), or Gelatin's /djs page when it has none. Gelatin can set a partner to always link to Gelatin's /djs page. Link to this one.

profile_url.description: Deprecated: use profile_page_url. The same page in its older form, https://<portal origin>/partner/djs/{slug} on a portal origin, which redirects (308) to profile_page_url. Kept so existing integrations keep working; no removal date yet. Without a portal origin it equals profile_page_url.

days.description: One entry per day, in order. Never says why a day is unavailable.
